scope: v0.26.5 RC1 attempt 25 is the major stabilization/cleanup candidate after user testing proved all 36 GLBs are detected but exposed a PowerShell automatic-variable collision in the prior lazy-card queue. PowerShell variable names are case-insensitive, so the old local $host assignment collided with read-only $Host before live-card logging could run; a new shipped-runtime AST safety audit subsequently found and fixed the same class of defect in Tools/Capture-ControllerDiagnostics.ps1 where $pid collided with read-only $PID. The safety audit now parses all shipped PowerShell runtimes and rejects protected automatic variables used as parameters, assignment/loop targets or dynamic variable-mutation targets before release transforms run. Platform presentation is consolidated to one authoritative V4 owner: HuymaierPlatformModels.ps1 is only the stable pre-3D presentation-base contract, HuymaierLivePlatformModels.ps1 is only GLB/Viewport3D and full-screen-viewer helpers, and HuymaierUser3DModels.ps1 V4 alone owns Games platform cards, platform rail dispatch, Settings > Customization controls, visual-mode toggle, icon/model scaling, user-model-folder action and final controller UI dispatch boundary. V4 uses visualHost rather than the reserved Host automatic variable, renders the proven icon card first, asynchronously upgrades matching cards one at a time, verifies GeometryCount/VertexCount before attachment, restores the icon on any failure, and logs detected/queued/ready/missing/failed presentation counts plus per-card readiness/failure. User-owned GLBs remain persistent in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Huymaier Console\3D Models or the optional portable 3D Models folder using the exact original 36 filenames; normal release bytes contain zero bundled GLBs. The retired atlas/static-preview architecture is removed from active startup/build ownership: HuymaierPlatformAtlas.ps1, HuymaierModelPreviewWorker.exe, Native\HuymaierBuiltInModelGenerator.cs, Assets\Models\platform-models.png and Assets\Models\Live are explicitly pruned from historical v0.26.2 staging and must be absent from the final candidate. Only one x64 HuymaierLiveModel3D.dll is compiled for live cards/viewer. The source visual gate renders real non-transparent card pixels (6864, 8468 after rotation, 6864 full viewer) and the staged candidate must repeat visible-pixel, queue-safety, single-owner, reserved-Host, no-retired-payload and zero-bundled-GLB gates against the packaged DLL. Unified browser cursor remains native-only; its context-state writes are now serialized with unique PID/GUID temp files and atomic File.Replace/File.Move to eliminate the observed file-already-exists race, while the legacy hc-virtual-cursor path remains retired. UI/render exceptions are caught at the final controller UI dispatch boundary so they cannot masquerade as native controller-polling failures. Preserve all previously proven GameCube, Downloads, Performance, native streaming, Sony Raw-HID, Game Bar, Wii/Dolphin, provider concurrency, installer rollback/tamper, Steam/Nintendo ownership and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 behavior. Upload only if exact source plus release-shaped installer/integrity, stabilization, native cursor/streaming/GameCube, cleaned staged live-3D presentation, download refresh, Steam ownership and final-hash gates all succeed together.
